parameters.jsCode:
const join = $('Normalize Join').first()?.json || {};
const hargaEventPromo = $('Normalize Harga Event Promo').first()?.json || {};
const jadwalCoach = $('Normalize Jadwal Coach').first()?.json || {};
const olahraga = $('Normalize Olahraga').first()?.json || {};
const knowledgeBase = $('Normalize Knowledge Base').first()?.json || {};

const incoming =
  $('Classify Conversation Micro Intent').first()?.json ||
  $('Normalize Incoming Message').first()?.json ||
  {};

const domains = [
  join,
  hargaEventPromo,
  jadwalCoach,
  olahraga,
  knowledgeBase
].filter(d => d && d.normalized_domain);

const activeDomain =
  domains.find(d => d.normalized_domain === 'join' && d.join_context?.type !== 'none') ||
  domains.find(d => d.normalized_domain === 'harga_event_promo' && d.harga_event_promo_context?.type !== 'none') ||
  domains.find(d => d.normalized_domain === 'jadwal_coach' && d.jadwal_coach_context?.type !== 'none') ||
  domains.find(d => d.normalized_domain === 'olahraga' && d.olahraga_context?.type !== 'none') ||
  domains.find(d => d.normalized_domain === 'knowledge_base' && d.knowledge_base_context?.type !== 'general_kb') ||
  domains[0] ||
  {};

const activeDomainName = String(activeDomain.normalized_domain || 'none');

const referenceData = {
  join: {
    context: join.join_context || null,
    flags: join.join_flags || {},
    join_ready_for_form: !!join.join_ready_for_form,
    join_info_only: !!join.join_info_only
  },

  harga_event_promo: {
    context: hargaEventPromo.harga_event_promo_context || null,
    flags: hargaEventPromo.harga_event_promo_flags || {},
    harga_rows: Array.isArray(hargaEventPromo.normalized_harga_rows)
      ? hargaEventPromo.normalized_harga_rows
      : [],
    promo_rows: Array.isArray(hargaEventPromo.normalized_promo_rows)
      ? hargaEventPromo.normalized_promo_rows
      : [],
    event_rows: Array.isArray(hargaEventPromo.normalized_event_rows)
      ? hargaEventPromo.normalized_event_rows
      : []
  },

  jadwal_coach: {
    context: jadwalCoach.jadwal_coach_context || null,
    flags: jadwalCoach.jadwal_coach_flags || {},
    schedule_rows: Array.isArray(jadwalCoach.normalized_schedule_rows)
      ? jadwalCoach.normalized_schedule_rows
      : [],
    coach_rows: Array.isArray(jadwalCoach.normalized_coach_rows)
      ? jadwalCoach.normalized_coach_rows
      : [],
    coach_names: Array.isArray(jadwalCoach.normalized_coach_names)
      ? jadwalCoach.normalized_coach_names
      : [],
    coach_keywords: Array.isArray(jadwalCoach.normalized_coach_keywords)
      ? jadwalCoach.normalized_coach_keywords
      : []
  },

  olahraga: {
    context: olahraga.olahraga_context || null,
    flags: olahraga.olahraga_flags || {},
    class_detail_payload: olahraga.normalized_class_detail_payload || null,
    class_detail_candidates: Array.isArray(olahraga.normalized_class_detail_candidates)
      ? olahraga.normalized_class_detail_candidates
      : []
  },

  knowledge_base: {
    context: knowledgeBase.knowledge_base_context || null,
    flags: knowledgeBase.knowledge_base_flags || {},
    kb_rows: Array.isArray(knowledgeBase.normalized_kb_rows)
      ? knowledgeBase.normalized_kb_rows
      : [],
    location_rows: Array.isArray(knowledgeBase.normalized_location_rows)
      ? knowledgeBase.normalized_location_rows
      : [],
    admin_rows: Array.isArray(knowledgeBase.normalized_admin_rows)
      ? knowledgeBase.normalized_admin_rows
      : [],
    social_rows: Array.isArray(knowledgeBase.normalized_social_rows)
      ? knowledgeBase.normalized_social_rows
      : [],
    about_rows: Array.isArray(knowledgeBase.normalized_about_rows)
      ? knowledgeBase.normalized_about_rows
      : [],
    location_text: String(knowledgeBase.normalized_location_text || '').trim(),
    admin_text: String(knowledgeBase.normalized_admin_text || '').trim(),
    social_text: String(knowledgeBase.normalized_social_text || '').trim(),
    about_text: String(knowledgeBase.normalized_about_text || '').trim()
  }
};

return {
  json: {
    ...incoming,

    active_domain: activeDomainName,
    active_domain_context:
      activeDomain.join_context ||
      activeDomain.harga_event_promo_context ||
      activeDomain.jadwal_coach_context ||
      activeDomain.olahraga_context ||
      activeDomain.knowledge_base_context ||
      null,

    reference_data: referenceData,

    collected_reference_summary: {
      active_domain: activeDomainName,
      join_mode: join.join_context?.type || 'none',
      harga_mode: hargaEventPromo.harga_event_promo_context?.type || 'none',
      jadwal_mode: jadwalCoach.jadwal_coach_context?.type || 'none',
      olahraga_mode: olahraga.olahraga_context?.type || 'none',
      kb_mode: knowledgeBase.knowledge_base_context?.type || 'general_kb'
    }
  }
};

const formText =
  'Siap Kak, aku bantu proses pendaftarannya ya!
Sebelum mulai, mohon isi data berikut terlebih dahulu agar kami bisa mengenal kebutuhan dan target latihan Kakak dengan lebih baik

' +
  'Nama:
' +
  'Domisili:
' +
  'Berat Badan:
' +
  'Tinggi Badan:
' +
  'Goals:
' +
  'Alasan Join:

';
return { json: { ...$input.first().json, dynamicFormText: formText, join_form_text: formText, replyText: formText, text: formText } };

parameters.jsCode:
const msg = $('Normalize Incoming Message').first().json || $json;
const rawUserMessage = String(msg.userMessage || '').trim();
const text = rawUserMessage.toLowerCase();

function hasAny(patterns) {
  return patterns.some((pattern) => pattern.test(text));
}

const greetingOnly = /^(halo|hallo|hai|hi|hey|hei|pagi|siang|sore|malam|assalamualaikum|permisi|halo kak|hai kak|hi kak)[\s!.,]*$/i.test(rawUserMessage);

const greetingPrefix = /^(halo|hallo|hai|hi|hey|hei|selamat pagi|selamat siang|selamat sore|selamat malam|assalamualaikum|permisi)[\s,!.]*/i.test(rawUserMessage);

const acknowledgementOnly = /^(oke|ok|okey|okay|baik|siap|sip|noted|terima kasih|makasih|makasi|thanks|thank you|ty|okee|baik kak|siap kak|oke kak|ok kak|terima kasih kak|makasih kak|sip kak)[\s!.,]*$/i.test(rawUserMessage);

const explicitJoinIntent = hasAny([
  /\bmau daftar\b/i,
  /\bpengen daftar\b/i,
  /\bingin daftar\b/i,
  /\bsaya mau daftar\b/i,
  /\baku mau daftar\b/i,
  /\bmau join\b/i,
  /\bpengen join\b/i,
  /\bingin join\b/i,
  /\bmau gabung\b/i,
  /\bpengen gabung\b/i,
  /\bingin gabung\b/i,
  /\blangsung daftar\b/i,
  /\bdaftar sekarang\b/i,
  /\bjoin sekarang\b/i,
  /\bbooking sekarang\b/i,
  /\bkirim form\b/i,
  /\bminta form\b/i,
  /\bisi form\b/i,
  /\bkirim formulir\b/i,
  /\bminta formulir\b/i,
  /\bisi formulir\b/i,
  /\bdaftar ya\b/i,
  /\bjoin ya\b/i,
]);

const registrationInfoIntent = hasAny([
  /\binfo join\b/i,
  /\binfo daftar\b/i,
  /\bjoin kelas\b/i,
  /\bgabung kelas\b/i,
  /\bcara daftar\b/i,
  /\bgimana daftar\b/i,
  /\bbagaimana daftar\b/i,
  /\bproses daftar\b/i,
  /\bsyarat daftar\b/i,
  /\binfo pendaftaran\b/i,
]);

const joinIntent = explicitJoinIntent;

const consultationIntent = hasAny([
  /\bkonsul\b/i,
  /\bkonsultasi\b/i,
  /\bsaran\b/i,
  /\brekomendasi\b/i,
  /\bcocok\b/i,
  /\bmenurut\b/i,
  /\bgimana baiknya\b/i,
  /\bbutuh arahan\b/i,
  /\bbingung pilih\b/i,
]);

const classDetailIntent = hasAny([
  /\bitu kayak gimana\b/i,
  /\bapa itu\b/i,
  /\bapa sih\b/i,
  /\bseperti apa\b/i,
  /\bjelasin\b/i,
  /\bpenjelasan\b/i,
  /\bdetail\b/i,
  /\bmaksudnya\b/i,
]);

const locationIntent = hasAny([
  /\balamat\b/i,
  /\blokasi\b/i,
  /\bdimana\b/i,
  /\bdi mana\b/i,
  /\bmaps\b/i,
  /\bgoogle map\b/i,
  /\bkepanjen\b/i,
  /\bmalang\b/i,
]);

const adminIntent = hasAny([
  /\badmin\b/i,
  /\bnomor admin\b/i,
  /\bkontak admin\b/i,
  /\bwa admin\b/i,
  /\bwhatsapp admin\b/i,
  /\bcs\b/i,
  /\bhubungi admin\b/i,
]);

const classNames = [
  '3 muscle',
  'bootypump',
  'trampoline class',
  'body combat',
  'tabata workout',
  'belly dance',
  'core',
  'power step',
  'fitdance',
  'boxing',
  'body transformation',
  'yoga',
  'strength training',
  'aerobic',
  'kegel',
  'stik flow',
  'hot mat pilates',
  'fitball',
  'hot twerk',
  'boxing woman',
  'special class'
];

const matchedClassNames = classNames.filter(name => text.includes(name));
const hasClassMention = matchedClassNames.length > 0;

const infoQuestionIntent = registrationInfoIntent || hasAny([
  /\bharga\b/i,
  /\bbiaya\b/i,
  /\bpaket\b/i,
  /\bkelas\b/i,
  /\bjadwal\b/i,
  /\bcoach\b/i,
  /\bpromo\b/i,
  /\btrial\b/i,
  /\bprogram\b/i,
  /\bmember\b/i,
  /\bpricelist\b/i,
  /\bprice list\b/i,
  /\bapa saja\b/i,
  /\bapa aja\b/i,
  /\bberapa\b/i,
  /\?/i,
]);

const isVeryShort = rawUserMessage.length > 0 && rawUserMessage.length <= 12;
const ambiguousIntent =
  !greetingOnly &&
  !acknowledgementOnly &&
  !joinIntent &&
  !consultationIntent &&
  !classDetailIntent &&
  !locationIntent &&
  !adminIntent &&
  !infoQuestionIntent &&
  isVeryShort;

let micro_intent = 'general_info';

if (greetingOnly) micro_intent = 'greeting';
else if (acknowledgementOnly) micro_intent = 'acknowledgement';
else if (joinIntent) micro_intent = 'join_intent';
else if (consultationIntent) micro_intent = 'consultation';
else if (classDetailIntent && hasClassMention) micro_intent = 'class_detail';
else if (locationIntent) micro_intent = 'location';
else if (adminIntent) micro_intent = 'admin_request';
else if (ambiguousIntent) micro_intent = 'ambiguous';
else if (infoQuestionIntent) micro_intent = 'info_request';

const shouldBypassMainLlm = greetingOnly || acknowledgementOnly;
const needsFollowupQuestion = micro_intent === 'ambiguous';
const conversationType =
  micro_intent === 'consultation'
    ? 'consultative'
    : ['info_request', 'class_detail', 'location', 'admin_request'].includes(micro_intent)
      ? 'informational'
      : micro_intent === 'join_intent'
        ? 'conversion'
        : 'light';

return {
  json: {
    ...msg,
    raw_user_message: rawUserMessage,
    micro_intent,
    conversation_type: conversationType,
    has_greeting_prefix: greetingPrefix,
    is_greeting_only: greetingOnly,
    is_acknowledgement_only: acknowledgementOnly,
    is_join_intent: joinIntent,
    is_registration_info_intent: registrationInfoIntent,
    is_consultation_intent: consultationIntent,
    is_class_detail_intent: classDetailIntent && hasClassMention,
    is_location_intent: locationIntent,
    is_admin_intent: adminIntent,
    is_ambiguous_intent: ambiguousIntent,
    matched_class_names: matchedClassNames,
    has_class_mention: hasClassMention,
    should_bypass_main_llm: shouldBypassMainLlm,
    needs_followup_question: needsFollowupQuestion
  }
};

values.content:
=Kamu adalah editor gaya bahasa untuk admin WhatsApp StepUp Ladies Gym.

Tugasmu hanya merapikan balasan agar terdengar lebih natural, hangat, luwes, dan seperti admin manusia di WhatsApp.

PENTING:
- Jangan ubah fakta.
- Jangan tambah fakta baru.
- Jangan ubah nama kelas, harga, alamat, jadwal, nomor admin, coach, promo, atau link.
- Jangan menghilangkan informasi penting.
- Jangan membuat jawaban lebih panjang dari yang perlu.
- Jangan terdengar seperti customer service robot, brosur, atau template kaku.

Tujuan edit:
- buat kalimat lebih enak dibaca
- buat lebih natural seperti chat admin WA
- hilangkan pengulangan yang aneh
- hilangkan CTA yang monoton atau terlalu robotik
- balasan seperti "oke kak", "siap kak", "terima kasih kak" dibuat lebih fleksibel bila perlu
- jika ada sapaan, gunakan maksimal satu sapaan saja
- jangan pernah membuat sapaan ganda

Aturan gaya:
- gunakan bahasa Indonesia yang natural
- sopan, hangat, singkat
- plain text saja
- jangan pakai markdown
- jangan pakai bullet kecuali memang isinya daftar
- jangan pakai emoji berlebihan
- kalau balasan sudah bagus, cukup perbaiki sedikit saja
- Jangan menambahkan ajakan hubungi admin atau isi data pendaftaran jika itu tidak ada di draft.

Output:
Tulis hanya balasan final yang sudah dirapikan. Jangan beri penjelasan.
